settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyText: Muslim Friend has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your data stays on your device. Internet is used only for Quran recitation audio you choose to play.
settings.quranCredit: Quran text: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani), © Tanzil Project, CC BY 3.0 — tanzil.net
settings.fontCredit: Arabic font: Amiri, © The Amiri Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1
settings.contentNote: Every hadith shows its source. Content is being reviewed by qualified people before release.
settings.shareText: Muslim Friend: Quran with tafsir, recitations and bookmarks, sourced athkar and prayer-time reminders. No ads.

onboarding.step3: A few permissions, at your pace
onboarding.promise: A quiet place for daily remembrance: no ads, no tracking, and works offline. Every dhikr comes with its source, so you can read with confidence.
onboarding.featuresHint: Choose what helps you. You can change these choices later in Settings.
onboarding.permissionsHint: We explain each permission before asking. You can leave any of them for later.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.reason: Allow reminders and the status notification that lets you manage Athkar over other apps.

overlay.title: Display over other apps
overlay.reason: Allow a short dhikr card to appear over other apps. Enable this permission on the next screen, then return here.

battery.title: Keep reminders running
battery.reason: Manufacturers such as Xiaomi, Samsung and Oppo may stop apps in the background. Review battery restrictions so reminders and Athkar cards can keep working.

location.title: Local prayer times
location.reason: Morning and evening reminders follow local prayer times. Use an approximate location, stored only to two decimal places on your device, or choose a city. Without a location, these reminders wait until you add one in Settings.

tips.xiaomi: Allow background activity and autostart, and choose No restrictions in the app’s battery settings. Menu names vary by device.
tips.samsung: Remove the app from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps in Battery settings. Menu names vary by device.
tips.oppo: Allow background activity and autolaunch in the app’s battery settings. Menu names vary by device.
tips.other: Look for background activity or unrestricted battery use in your device settings. Available options vary by device.

onboarding.granted: Permission is already allowed. You can continue.
onboarding.noCities: No matching cities. Try another name.
onboarding.allSet: You’re ready. You can review permissions and reminders in Settings at any time.
onboarding.error: This action could not be completed. Please try again, or continue with Not now.

overlay.title: Overlay settings
overlay.fallbackPermission: Permission to appear over other apps is missing. Athkar will be shown as notifications instead.
overlay.fallbackRestricted: Android did not allow the background service to start. Athkar will be shown as notifications instead.
overlay.permissionText: To show a short dhikr while you use other apps, allow Muslim Friend to appear on top in Android settings. Return here and tap Start overlay when you are done.
overlay.notificationExplanation: A persistent notification keeps the overlay service active and lets you pause or stop it. Android 13 and later may ask for notification permission when you start.
overlay.notificationMissing: Notification permission is off. Allow it when prompted to see the persistent notification and notification reminders.
overlay.longText: Passages longer than {{count}} characters are skipped. You can still read them in their categories.
overlay.batteryText: Some phones, including Xiaomi, Samsung and Oppo, stop background apps to save power. Allow background activity so athkar can continue appearing.
overlay.batteryOk: OK — battery optimisation is disabled for this app.
overlay.settingsUnavailable: Battery settings could not be opened. Open this app’s battery settings from Android Settings.
overlay.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
overlay.notificationText: Athkar overlay is active. Pause or stop it here.

tips.xiaomi: Enable Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions for Muslim Friend.
tips.samsung: Go to Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps and add Muslim Friend.
tips.oppo: Allow Auto launch and background activity for Muslim Friend.
tips.huawei: Open App launch, choose Muslim Friend and manage launch manually. Allow background activity.
tips.generic: In your phone’s app settings, allow Muslim Friend to run in the background and remove battery restrictions.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no accounts. Everything works offline; the only internet use is Quran recitation audio when you play or download it.
privacy.collectText: Nothing. We never receive any personal or usage data.
privacy.deviceText: Your settings, your own athkar, list order, daily counts, tasbih counters and statistics. Uninstalling the app deletes them. Android cloud backup is disabled.
privacy.permissionsText: Internet only for recitation audio you ask for; display over other apps and a foreground service (only if you enable the overlay or floating counter); notifications for reminders; start at boot to restore them; vibration for counting.
privacy.locationText: Only if you choose automatic location for prayer times: read once, rounded to about 1 km, stored on the device and never shared. You can pick a city instead.
privacy.backupText: Export creates a file and opens the share sheet. You decide where it goes; the app uploads nothing. Recitations are requested from everyayah.com only when you play or download them.
